name: Flore Milfia
original_name: フローレ・ミルフィア
source:
Flore, as she looked 3 years prior to the events in [url=/v873]Little Witch Parfait[/url]. In this game she is an 11-year-old girl who attends the elementary school of Flor Hermos Magic Academy. Flore lives with her mom, loves flowers and has a flower garden she enjoys to maintain. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%81%8A%E8%8A%B1%E7%95%91%E3%81%AE%E3%83%95%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AC]Wikipedia[/url].]
